launch_command:
cat > lettabot.yaml <<EOF
server:
  mode: docker
  baseUrl: http://127.0.0.1:${CLAWGAP_PROVIDER_PORT}
  api:
    host: 127.0.0.1
    port: 18085
agent:
  id: clawgap-fake-agent
  name: ClawGapEnvironmentProbe
channels:
  mock:
    enabled: true
features:
  cron: false
  heartbeat:
    enabled: false
polling:
  enabled: false
EOF
mkdir -p "$HOME/workspace/.letta/agents" "$PWD/data" && cp vendor-source/letta-code-v0.19.5/src/agent/subagents/builtin/reflection.md vendor-source/letta-code-v0.19.5/src/agent/subagents/builtin/history-analyzer.md vendor-source/letta-code-v0.19.5/src/agent/subagents/builtin/explore.md "$HOME/workspace/.letta/agents/" && export LETTA_BASE_URL="http://127.0.0.1:${CLAWGAP_PROVIDER_PORT}" LETTA_API_KEY=clawgap-loopback-mock LETTABOT_CONFIG="$PWD/lettabot.yaml" DATA_DIR="$PWD/data" WORKING_DIR="$HOME/workspace" LETTA_CODE_TELEM=0 && node --import ./lettabot_mock_channel_register.mjs dist/main.js
